name: cmux.sidebar/1
docs: The whole workspace list, drawn by an extension in place of the built-in one. The person opts in by naming the app in sidebar.workspaceListApp; the built-in list stays the default and the fallback whenever the extension is not chosen, not installed, loading, failing, or apps cannot run (safe mode).
status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
